blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala takes on British teen Mika Stojsavljevic in the round of 32 of the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, Japan. The match marks the first-ever meeting between Eala and the 17-year-old Stojsavljevic, who entered the WTA 500 event as a wild card. Stojsavljevic won the US Open girls singles in 2024, two years after Eala ruled the event.
